# Pull request

## What does this change?

<!-- One or two sentences. If it fixes an open issue, write "Fixes #12". -->

## Why?

<!-- What was wrong, or what is better afterwards. Skip if it is obvious. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Accessibility fix
- [ ] Content correction (typo, dead link, wrong information)
- [ ] Code cleanup or refactor — no behaviour change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` completes without errors
- [ ] I checked the change in the browser, not just in the editor
- [ ] I checked it at a narrow width (≈390px) as well as on desktop
- [ ] Colors and fonts come from the tokens in `src/styles/tokens.css` rather
      than hardcoded values
- [ ] No new dependencies — or if there are, I opened an issue about it first
- [ ] The change is focused on one thing
